questions.question: In Alien, what is the name of the warrant officer played by Sigourney Weaver?
questions.note: She returns in Aliens, Alien 3, and Alien Resurrection.

questions.question: What 1999 film asks you to choose between a red pill and a blue pill?
questions.note: Red pill: the truth. Blue pill: back to the simulation.

questions.question: Who created Star Wars?
questions.note: He directed A New Hope and the prequels; Kershner directed Empire.

questions.question: What is the name of the hotel in The Shining?
questions.note: Stephen King was inspired by Colorado’s Stanley Hotel; Kubrick’s film uses the Overlook.

questions.question: In Blade Runner, what are the artificial humans called?
questions.note: Harrison Ford’s Deckard hunts them in a rainy 2019 Los Angeles.

questions.question: What 1973 horror film about a possessed girl was directed by William Friedkin?
questions.note: Linda Blair as Regan; “the power of Christ compels you.”

questions.question: In Back to the Future, what kind of car is the time machine?
questions.note: A DMC-12; it needs 1.21 gigawatts and a flux capacitor.

questions.question: What 1982 Steven Spielberg film features a friendly alien who wants to “phone home”?
choices: Close Encounters of the Third Kind
questions.note: Drew Barrymore is Gertie; the boy is Elliott.

questions.question: Which 1979 Ridley Scott film used the tagline “In space, no one can hear you scream”?
questions.note: The xenomorph and the Nostromo; Scott returned decades later with Prometheus.

questions.question: What planet is Superman from?
questions.note: He lands in Kansas and grows up as Clark Kent.
